input_preparation.subset_rule: First 1000 entries of the fixed ordered 30000-person list; exact subset list is retained privately and identified by its SHA-256.

normalizations.fnit_voxel_zscore: (image - voxel_mean) / voxel_population_std; zero std replaced by 0.1

initialization.dense_cpu_baseline_limitation: 1000-person reference only; full Y in RAM, not large-cohort out-of-core CPU

CPU100.dense_cpu_limitation: 1000-person reference only; full Y loaded in RAM

CPU100_profile.method: Sum the six original-source per-update clocks: eta, H, HlambdaHt/W, X, mixture, lambda. F is outside these clocks.
CPU100_profile.limitations: F was not timed independently. The residual F estimate includes dictionary/log/progress-write overhead; update clocks use time.time().

brainmap_OLS_t.comparison: OLS t-stat with intercept. final_H uses mature FNIT SpatialRegression default thresholds for both H. same_H_arithmetic uses identical NumPy rcond=1e-15 inverse/se matrices for NumPy and CUDA products. same_H_default_API additionally measures mature API threshold plus arithmetic differences.

memory_plan.note: Allocator cap is 19GiB; CUDA context/cuBLAS are separately observed, leaving 1GiB under 20GiB.

GPU100_current_main_zstat.comparison_scope: native_cpu_vs_gpu uses source NumPy/SciPy OLS-z with CPU H vs mature FNIT CUDA OLS-z with GPU H. same_H_native uses CPU H on both backends. same_t_z_conversion isolates SciPy vs mature CUDA Student-t conversion for identical mature CPU-H t. final_H_cuda uses mature CUDA OLS-z for both final H.
